name: Refugee Status / International and Temporary Protection

requirements.blocker_text: North Macedonia is party to the 1951 Refugee Convention and its 1967 Protocol. The Sector for Asylum within the Ministry of Interior is the administrative body responsible for the asylum procedure, governed by the 2018 Law on International and Temporary Protection (which replaced the 2003 Law on Asylum and Temporary Protection).
requirements.fix_path: File an application with the Ministry of Interior's Sector for Asylum.

sources.title: UNHCR Help North Macedonia -- confirms the Ministry of Interior's Sector for Asylum as the deciding body and North Macedonia's party status to the 1951 Convention and 1967 Protocol
Refworld -- catalog entry for North Macedonia's Law on International and Temporary Protection (11 April 2018), confirming it replaced the 2003 Law on Asylum and Temporary Protection
